2.content:
claude.md -- 1st Central Digital T&Cs (Agent Workflow, DEMO)

Purpose: demo for 1st Central's Digital T&Cs POC (UK requirement: evidence the customer read the terms on any channel). Agent captures name, policy number, terms document and delivery channel, then either sends a read-and-accept link (Email/Text) or reads the terms aloud (Voice). Cloned 1:1 from the internal consent-form demo pair (agent tree 719122074, org 582102); same node ids and routing.

Node map: 1 Intake -> 17 resolve terms (dictionary) -> 6 build link -> 7 route by consent_preference -> 8 Text (Twilio, NOT live) / 9 Email / 10 Voice deflect -> 11 Voice read-aloud script -> 12 Terms Accepted. Digital path: 13 waiting -> 16 Data (CO 1197 get_session_data) -> 14 is_terms_accepted == 1? -> 18 terms_score contains "addons"? -> 19 optional extras answered? -> 12. Not accepted -> 15 (retry -> 16, resend -> 7).

Data dictionary: terms_score (5 values, node 1 "Terms Document" select) -> terms_instruction, document_name, product, document_version (form) + transforms.terms_html via node 17's termsData (mirrored in Customer tree node 4 -- keep in sync). Node 6 sets terms_form_link and customer_terms_session_id and forwards zv_terms_score, zv_policy_number, zv_customer_name. Read back from the customer session: is_terms_accepted, terms_signature, terms_accepted_at, addon_legal_protection, addon_breakdown.

External systems: Connected Object 1197 (get_session_data, http, org 582102) reads the Customer tree session by session_id -- reused from the source demo pair; if imported into another org, recreate it there and update node 16. Twilio (node 8) is a placeholder Data node with no CO, same as the source pair.

Setup: after importing the Customer tree, put its tree id in CUSTOMER_TREE_ID at the top of node 6. Until then the emailed link is broken.

Gotchas: ALL T&Cs wording is demo sample text (banner shown on every render), not 1st Central's approved terms. "addons" in the terms_score is what triggers the Optional Extras screen in both trees.

Changelog

  • 2026-10-20 -- Created from the consent-form demo agent tree 719122074 (2026-09-01 version) for the 1st Central Digital T&Cs demo. Swapped the client consent dictionary for a 5-document sample T&Cs catalogue, renamed variables to terms_document/terms_score/is_terms_accepted, dropped the Preferred Language field, added policy_number, rebranded copy, gave the node 11 checkbox a name and made it required, node 12 now shows the customer's signed name, accepted timestamp and optional-extras answers. Nodes touched: 1, 2, 6, 7-19 (copy/variables only; routing unchanged).
